schemaChangesSince0_2_0: students.declaredAgeAtCourseStart (nullable integer): the age completed on the course's first day, used when dateOfBirth is empty
crews.capacity (nullable integer): normalised on read (D2-D5 the standard pair, others the member count or four) and stored on the first crew save of a session
crewMembers.position keeps its column: 0.2.0 stored a packed index, today it is a seat index, so a packed 0.2.0 crew reads as seats 0..n-1 and a part-full pair leaves the second seat free
no new table; the persistence read functions changed (A terra ordered by name, evaluation saves in one transaction, erase-all-course-data) without a data change
